column2: order   = numeric prefix of the emitted .patch file; also the apply order
path    = path relative to the carla_garage repo root
tier    = REQUIRED  -> in the dependency closure of the 475 canonical routes
INCLUDED  -> our benchmark code, shipped, but NOT exercised by the 475
git     = tracked-modified | tracked-new | untracked-new  (state in the private worktree)
reason  = one line, why this file is in the patch set
